finding: Packet completeness and subject-manifest integrity are insufficient when verified independently; promotion requires a fail-closed coherence gate proving that marker and manifest identify the same repository, exact source commit, receipt path, receipt bytes, and receipt size.

source_status.reason_external_research_not_required: The finding concerns current internal evidence contracts and was derived from exact source inspection rather than a time-sensitive external behavior claim.

uncertainty: The gate verifies exact-byte and cross-artifact identity only. It does not authenticate the producer, prove GitHub Actions coverage, establish deployment identity, demonstrate runtime behavior, or prove physical-device audibility.
falsification_route: Construct a marker and manifest that disagree on repository, source commit, receipt digest, receipt size, or receipt inclusion; the verifier must return verified=false. A future bypass that returns verified=true falsifies the contract.
privacy_boundary: Only repository operational metadata and synthetic test fixtures were used.
